intro.text: A Veden highprince, one of many appointed by King Taravangian after the old nobility was wiped out in the civil war.

items.text: At a war council in Urithiru's Gallery of Maps, Urian argued for defending a fertile, storm-sheltered strip of Veden land east of the Horneater Peaks, saying it could be a base for recruiting Horneaters and would expose Jah Keved if lost. Dalinar, who had fought there, agreed.

appearance.text: Tall, with short black hair, he is prim and wears an Alethi-style military uniform.

personality.text: He uses the honorific Nan as a firstborn and speaks more than his younger brother; he knows some military strategy and speaks Alethi.
